The longest river in the world is the Nile River.

To help understand the concept of inflation theory in cosmology, imagine you have a tiny, wrinkled piece of paper representing the early universe. Inflation theory suggests that this paper was stretched out incredibly fast, becoming smooth and vast in a fraction of a second. This is similar to blowing up a balloon: when you start with a small, deflated balloon and quickly inflate it, the surface area expands rapidly, making the balloon much larger than it was initially. This rapid expansion helps explain why the universe is so uniform and large today.
